component.name: Cloud PC Connect
component.summary: Windows 365, Dev Box and Azure Virtual Desktop for Omarchy

description.p: Cloud PC Connect is a fork of AVD Feed + Connect by Shakeel Osmani, built for Omarchy and Hyprland. Sign in with your work account to list the Cloud PCs, Dev Boxes and remote apps you have access to, then open them over RDP with the bundled FreeRDP client.

ul.li: Follows the live Omarchy theme, fonts and corner radius
Cloud PCs listed first, with filters and search for the rest
Opens each Cloud PC on the Hyprland workspace you pick
Adds Cloud PCs to the app launcher with their own icon
FIDO2 security keys for sign-in and inside the remote session
Teams call optimization on by default

description.p: This is an unofficial client. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft or the Omarchy project.
